descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
🧟 The apocalypse has begun… and the clock is ticking 🧟

💥 Jump into a fast-paced VR arcade zombie shooter built for pure adrenaline and stress relief! Blast through relentless waves of the undead using dual-wield weapons, quick reflexes, and smart positioning to survive as long as possible 💥

⏱️ Every match is a race against time. Eliminate zombies to earn valuable Time Rewards and keep the clock alive. The longer you survive, the faster and more chaotic the action becomes ⏱️

🧠 Face multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Unlock powerful Perks, complete Daily Challenges and Daily Special Missions, and adapt on the fly to stay alive 🧠

🌍 Fight across unique maps, earn cash from every kill, and unlock new locations as you push deeper into the apocalypse 🌍

🚁 Trigger random power-ups and call in military support including air strikes, attack helicopters, and robotic turrets when the horde becomes overwhelming 🚁

🏆 Climb the Leaderboard, beat your personal best, and uncover a hidden story through cryptic transmissions, classified documents, and buried secrets 🏆

🔥 Easy to jump into, hard to master, and packed with nonstop VR arcade action. Survival is never guaranteed 🔥

💀 Shoot fast. React faster. Survive the apocalypse 💀
